sources.title: Fortis Healthcare Buys Bengalurus Suguna Hospital For ₹277 Crore, Boosts City Bed Capacity To 1,000

synopsis: Fortis Healthcare Limited, via its wholly-owned subsidiary International Hospital Limited, acquired Bengaluru-based Suguna Hospital for approximately Rs 277 crore in a cash consideration deal. The transaction encompasses a business transfer agreement for the entire operations of Suguna Ramaiah Hospitals Private Limited alongside a sale deed for the hospital's land and building. The deal was consummated on October 28, 2026. Suguna Hospital is a 110-bedded tertiary-care multispecialty hospital in Rajajinagar, Bengaluru, with shareholders consisting of Dr Ramaiah Ravindra holding 80.91%, Mrs Suguna Ramaiah holding 14.55%, and Mrs Sujatha Ravindra holding 4.54%. The acquisition aligns with Fortis's cluster-focused inorganic growth strategy in Bengaluru, expanding its operational bed capacity in the city to approximately 1,000 beds.
